claim.claim-text: 1. A method of antimicrobial sanitizing and/or disinfecting treatment and bleaching of laundry, the method comprising:

a. washing the laundry with a peroxyformic acid composition at a pH range from about 4 to about 7 in a laundry washing machine for antimicrobial efficacy on the laundry, wherein the peroxyformic acid composition is generated through reaction of an ester of a polyhydric alcohol, formic acid and hydrogen peroxide; thereafter b. adding an alkalinity source to the washing machine to increase the pH range to at least above 9, preferably at least about 10.5, in the laundry washing machine; thereafter c. adding a bleach activator and/or catalyst composition to boost the bleaching efficacy of the peroxyformic acid composition on the laundry in the laundry washing machine; and optionally applying a detergent use solution to remove soil from the laundry at any point in the method of sanitizing and/or disinfecting and bleaching of the laundry; d. draining the peroxyformic acid composition, the detergent use solution, and the bleach activator and/or catalyst composition from the laundry, wherein (i) the peroxyformic acid composition has a ratio of peroxyformic acid to hydrogen peroxide of 1:1 (w/w) to 1:3 (w/w).
2. The method of claim 1, peroxyformic acid composition is applied to the laundry in the laundry washing machine at a pH from about 5 to about 7, from about 6 to about 8, or about 7.

3. The method of any one of claims 1-2, wherein the peroxyformic acid composition is applied to the laundry in the laundry washing machine for about 3 to about 15 minutes, or for about 5 to about 10 minutes, or wherein the detergent use solution and the bleach activator and/or catalyst composition is applied to the laundry in the laundry washing machine for about 3 to about 15 minutes, or for about 5 to about 10 minutes.

4. The method of any one of claims 1-3, wherein the peroxyformic acid composition is provided to the laundry washing machine at an actives level from about 5 ppm to about 200 ppm, or from about 5 ppm to about 80 ppm.
5. The method of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the alkalinity source increases the pH range to at least above 10, from about 10 to about 11, or at least about 11.

6. The method of any one of claims 1-5, wherein the detergent use solution comprises an alkalinity agent comprising at least one of alkali metal hydroxide, alkali metal silicate, alkali metal carbonate or other base component.

7. The method of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the bleach activator is tetraacetylethylene diamine, sodium nonanoyloxybenzene sulfonate (NOBS), acetyl capro- lactone, N-methyl morpholinium acetonitrile or combinations thereof.
8. The method of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the bleach catalyst is a transition metal catalyst.
9. The method of claim 8, wherein the transition metal catalyst is a manganese containing compound.

10. The method of any one of claims 1-9, further comprising a step of adding additional hydrogen peroxide to the wash of the laundry washing machine before or after the addition of the peroxyformic acid composition, before or after the addition of the detergent use solution, before or after the addition of the alkalinity source, and/or before or after the addition of the bleach activator and/or catalyst to increase the bleaching efficacy of the peroxyformic acid composition.

11. The method of any one of claims 1-10, further comprising a step of rinsing the peroxyformic acid composition, the detergent use solution and the bleach activator and/or catalyst composition from the laundry.
12. The method of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the method of sanitizing and/or disinfecting and bleaching laundry follows an initial washing step for the laundry.

13. The method of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the ester of a polyhydric alcohol and formic acid comprises glycerol formates, pentaerythritol formates, mannitol formates, propylene glycol formates, sorbitol formates and sugar formates.
14. The method of any one of claims 1-13, wherein the peroxyformic acid composition further comprises a catalyst and/or a stabilizing agent.
15. The method of claim 1, wherein the method is carried out in the presence of methane sulfonic acid as catalyst.
